component.name: Termoso
component.summary: SSH, SFTP and terminal client with an encrypted vault

description.p: Termoso keeps your hosts, keys and snippets in a vault that is encrypted on your device, syncs them to your own server or none at all, and gives you a fast terminal, SFTP with resume and folder sync, port forwarding, Mosh, Telnet and serial consoles.
Teams get shared vaults with roles, SSO, audit and session recordings on a self-hosted server.
